Production persistence, service registration, app adoption, settings/capability/identity runtime wiring, notification UI, delivery, and target behavior require Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit Integration Owner checkpoint naming NOTIFY-01.
registry_entry.merge_boundary: Dedicated codex/0.2-notify-01 branch only; integrate through an explicit checkpoint after review, and never merge directly to main or another workstream branch.

proposed_host_test_command.note: 24 host acceptance tests, library/doc-test targets, format check, and warning-denied Clippy passed in /Users/tozawa/.codex/worktrees/notify-01/NagiOS using the repository-pinned arm64 nightly toolchain. These host checks do not establish durable production persistence, service activation, UI, delivery, or runtime integration acceptance.

integration_owner_actions: Review the registered host-only foundation when selecting the next integration checkpoint.

After Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit checkpoint naming NOTIFY-01, assign/version production identity, capability, policy, diagnostics, persistence, service IPC, and UI adapter contracts before runtime integration.
Do not merge this dedicated branch directly to main or another workstream branch.
scope_notes: The registration has only development-foundation as a hard dependency. Unregistered Identity, Settings, SVC-IPC, and app lifecycle work are adapter targets, not implied dependencies or edit permission.
The standalone crate depends on the existing nagi-localization 0.1.0 MessageId and LocaleContext types. It does not add catalog messages.
AppId and M6 ServiceId remain owned by their existing contracts and are represented through generic identity adapters; this crate defines no competing app/service/profile identity.

Capability, profile, source identity, policy, localization rendering, persistence, diagnostics, and UI behavior are injected. Current tests use host-only mocks; no production runtime adapter is active.

No notification UI, banner, toast, push/cloud/mobile push, email, SMS, app adoption, Settings key, root workspace/CI, shared schema, IDL/ABI, M18, M17/M30 implementation, or other workstream source/state is included.
The workstream is registered. Its state is now part of the root ./nagi dev verify target; PASS in this record covers the host Foundation acceptance only.

ci_proposal.reason: The notification crate is intentionally standalone and is not a root workspace member; current CI workspace format, Clippy, build, and test commands therefore do not compile or run its 24 acceptance cases.
ci_proposal.ownership_note: A later Integration Owner/CI-acceptance checkpoint should approve and apply the shared workflow change; .github/workflows/ci.yml is forbidden to this workstream.
